title: Finding and Handling Missing Values
learning_objectives: Detect missing values with isna and count them per column
Drop incomplete rows only for the columns that matter
Fill missing values with per-column defaults
Explain how pandas reductions skip NaN, compared with a manual loop
entry_point: missing_report(df); drop_incomplete(df, cols); fill_defaults(df, defaults); mean_skipping_missing(values)
hints: `{str(c): int(n) for c, n in df.isna().sum().items()}`.
Skip `v is None` and floats where `math.isnan(v)`; divide the sum by the count of kept values.

failure_feedback.advice: Count with `df.isna().sum()` and convert to a dict of ints.
Pass `subset=` to dropna and reset the index.
`df.fillna(defaults)` returns a new frame; do not fill in place.
Skip None and NaN values; return None when nothing is left.
